collection.title: Audi A6 Saloon 2001 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: An Audi A6 Saloon 2001 to 2004 model requires a 22" wiper blade for both the drivers and passengers side with a Slider Fit arm attachment. All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle.
